name: Bronzeville Youth Shelter (emergency shelter for ages 14 to 17)
what_you_do: A safe, temporary place to stay for teens with nowhere to go. Ignite also runs a drop-in resource center.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 14 to 17 who need a safe place to stay.
pay_detail: Cost is not stated on the page.
deadline_text: No deadline. A 24/7 help line is listed.
how_to_apply: Call the 24/7 crisis line at 866-803-8336 or text 312-625-1858. The shelter is at 3745 S. Indiana Ave., Chicago.
notes: This is a safe place to stay, not a job. The page does not say how a teen gets a bed beyond calling the help line. If you are in danger right now, call 911.
